name: Crimson Gauntlet
space: highsec / lowsec / nullsec (per 2020 infobox; 2026 page does not restate)
enemies: Level 3, three rooms. Warp-in: 0-3 frigates (Harvest Shepherd/Savior/Follower), 0-5 cruisers (Harvest Prophet/Sage), 0-2 battlecruisers (Harvest Diviner). Rooms 2 and 3: two waves each of 0-12 frigates (Savior/Shepherd/Exsanguinator/Follower), 0-2 destroyers (Harvest Cleric), 0-8 cruisers (Prophet/Sage), 0-2 battlecruisers (Diviner). Boss wave in room 3: 1 Harvest Overseer battleship (web, neut, point). Chance of an Abyssal rift spawn (Rogue Drone, Triglavian or Sleeper group with a boss) after clearing room 1 or 2. Incoming DPS can approach 600 if the boss spawns with a third wave.
ship_limit: Battleship (2020 infobox). Secure Shortcut Gate needs a Crimson Gauntlet Shortcut Keypass and skips to room 3.
danger_note: Three rooms, heavy web/neut/scram, battleship boss, up to ~600 DPS
notes: Loot: Mutated Blood Samples, Overseer Sabik Vials, Mobile Sanguine Harvester BPC, rare Dark Blood modules. Killing the boss decloaks a Dark Blood Transmission Relay which can escalate to Crimson Harvest Sanctuary. NPCs can warp to tactical bookmarks and aggress drones.

name: Tetrimon Base
space: highsec / lowsec / nullsec (not restated on page; assumed same as Crimson Gauntlet)
enemies: Level 3, three rooms. Warp-in: 2 frigates (Tetrimon Crucifier, Crusader), 0-3 destroyers (Heretic), 0-6 cruisers (Augoror, Curse, Omen), 0-2 battlecruisers (Oracle). Rooms 2 and 3: two waves each of 0-8 frigates, 0-3 destroyers, 0-9 cruisers (Augoror remote-reps, Curse neuts ~100 GJ/5s), 0-2 Oracle battlecruisers (100% EM, very high DPS at 20 km). Final wave room 3: 1 Tetrimon Commander battleship (web, point). Possible Abyssal rift spawn with Pochven boss. Rats aggressively target drones.
ship_limit: Not stated (Crimson Gauntlet sibling: Battleship). Secure Shortcut Gate needs a Tetrimon Shortcut Keypass.
danger_note: Very high EM DPS, heavy neuts, remote reps, drone aggression, battleship boss
notes: 2025 report: a corvette was destroyed on warp-in. Boss drops Tetrimonic Warclone Blanks. Decloaked Tetrimon Transmission Relay may escalate to Tetrimon Garrison.

name: Tetrimon Garrison
subkind: escalation (from Decloaked Tetrimon Transmission Relay in Tetrimon Base)
enemies: Level 5, single pocket. Waves 1-4: 0-8 frigates (Crucifier, Crusader), 0-3 destroyers (Heretic), 0-10 cruisers (Augoror, Curse, Omen), 0-2 Oracle battlecruisers. Boss wave: 1 Tetrimon Captain battleship (web, 30 GJ/s neut).
danger_note: Level 5, four waves then 30 GJ/s neuting battleship boss
notes: Boss may drop Imperial Navy faction modules.

name: Crimson Harvest Sanctuary
subkind: escalation (from Decloaked Dark Blood Transmission Relay in Crimson Gauntlet)
enemies: Level 5, single room with Cthonic Attar asteroids. Waves 1-4: 0-12 frigates, 0-2 destroyers, 0-8 cruisers, 0-2 battlecruisers (Harvest line). Boss wave: 1 Harvest Overseer / Controller battleship (web, neut, point).
danger_note: Level 5, four waves then battleship boss with neut and web
notes: Boss may drop Dark Blood faction modules and Mobile Sanguine Harvester BPC.

name: Criterion of Fitness
space: anywhere in known space (gated; requires a Criterion Cipher dropped by Pochven boss spawns in Crimson Gauntlet / Tetrimon Base or from Captured Bioadaptive Caches)
enemies: Three timed trial waves of Triglavians (Raznaborg/Hospodar variants). Wave 1 ~5 ships (0-2 Damavik, 0-2 Kikimora, 0-1 Rodiva, 0-1 Drekavac). Wave 2 up to ~10 ships adding 0-3 Vedmak, 0-3 Drekavac, 0-1 Leshak. Wave 3 up to ~15 ships incl. 1-4 Leshak battleships. Boss wave by fitness score: Superior Drekavac (31 GJ/s neut), Superior Leshak (21 GJ/s neut) or Zorya's Babaroga (~550 DPS, bastion +200% damage). Criterion Cache spawns on boss kill.
ship_limit: Gate deactivates after one ship passes; effectively solo only
recommended_ship: Best run with a marauder; less well tanked ships are doable if you accept possibly skipping the full rewards
danger_note: Up to 4 battleships per wave, officer-class boss, solo-locked gate
notes: ~200-250M ISK per run reported. Same loot and salvage tables as Pochven NPCs.

name: Hollow Outbreak
space: Class 1: highsec; Class 2: all areas; Class 3: lowsec, nullsec, wormholes, Pochven
faction: unknown (page body is carried over from the 2025 Biocybernetic Incident text)
enemies: No NPC table. Three classes: Class 1 balanced for new players in basic Tech I frigates; Class 2 for Tech I destroyers / Tech II frigates and lower; Class 3 for veterans flying up to Tech III destroyers. 'Newly Constructed Acceleration Gate' at warp-in.
ship_limit: Class 1 gate restricted to Atron, Breacher, Condor, Executioner, Incursus, Kestrel, Merlin, Punisher, Rifter, Slasher, Tormentor, Tristan
recommended_ship: Class 1: basic Tech I frigate; Class 2: Tech I destroyer or Tech II frigate; Class 3: up to Tech III destroyer
danger_note: Class-scaled frigate/destroyer content; 2 for Class 1 up to 3 for Class 3
notes: Only a heading plus class list on the 2026 page; in-game names likely carry a 'Class N' suffix. Verify.

name: Biocybernetic Incident
space: Class 1: highsec; Class 2: all areas; Class 3: lowsec, nullsec, wormholes, Pochven (Class 3 also highsec from 28 Oct 2025)
faction: unknown (Upwell cloning experiments gone wrong; EDENCOM ships barred from entering)
enemies: No NPC table. Stay inside a perimeter for a set time fighting waves of enemies, then a more formidable foe; loot-laden shuttles try to escape; unstable generators can be detonated to damage many ships at once (and you).
ship_limit: Class 1 gate restricted to Atron, Breacher, Condor, Executioner, Incursus, Kestrel, Merlin, Punisher, Rifter, Slasher, Tormentor, Tristan
recommended_ship: Class 1: basic Tech I frigate; Class 2: Tech I destroyer or Tech II frigate; Class 3: up to Tech III destroyer
danger_note: Frigate/destroyer-scaled waves; 2 for Class 1 up to 3 for Class 3
notes: In-game names appear as 'Biocybernetic Incident: Class 1' etc. per linked video title. Replaced by Hollow Outbreak heading in 2026.

name: Tetrimon Frontline Base
space: lowsec constellations Eugidi, Angils, Essin (plus Semou, Jayal, Hed from 28 Oct 2025) and Blood Raider controlled systems in Delve
enemies: No composition recorded. Described as rarer and tougher advanced site with greater rewards; 'Bring allies'.
danger_note: Advanced site, CCP advises bringing allies; composition unknown

name: Dark Blood Gauntlet
space: lowsec constellations Eugidi, Angils, Essin (plus Semou, Jayal, Hed from 28 Oct 2025) and Blood Raider controlled systems in Delve
enemies: No composition recorded. Described as rarer and tougher advanced site with greater rewards; 'Bring allies'.
danger_note: Advanced site, CCP advises bringing allies; composition unknown

name: Crimson Harvest Network Node
enemies: No NPCs. One room, three cans 20-40 km from warp-in, sometimes a fourth 'Unresolved Bioadaptive Cache'. Level III. Failing a hack twice destroys the can (bioadaptive cache has unlimited tries).
danger_note: No NPCs; hacking only
notes: Loot includes Overseer Sabik Vials (1M ISK to NPC buy orders), shortcut keypasses, SKINs, boosters, Radiance accelerators, filaments, Criterion Cipher via Captured Bioadaptive Cache.

name: Crimson Harvest Network Hub
enemies: No NPCs. Lowsec variant of the Network Node: one room, three cans 20-40 km out, occasional fourth can. Level III.
danger_note: No NPCs; hacking only

name: Tetrimon Network Node
enemies: No NPCs. One room, three cans 20-40 km out, occasional fourth 'Unresolved Bioadaptive Cache'. Level III.
danger_note: No NPCs; hacking only
notes: Drops Tetrimonic Warclone Blanks (1M ISK to Blood Raider NPC buy orders in Delve).

name: Tetrimon Network Hub
enemies: No NPCs. Lowsec variant of the Tetrimon Network Node. Level III.
danger_note: No NPCs; hacking only

name: Shining Flame Base
enemies: Class 3. Warp-in: 4 ships drawn from Shining Flame Crusader/Deacon/Crucifier frigates, Curse/Augoror/Omen cruisers, Oracle battlecruisers. 1st pocket: two waves of 3-9 ships of the same mix plus 21 Cthonic Attar asteroids. 2nd pocket: two waves of 6 ships, then 1 Shining Flame Commander battleship (scram, web). Rats warp to on-grid pings then land on you.
ship_limit: Battleship. Secure Shortcut Gate needs a Shining Flame Base Shortcut Keypass.
danger_note: Remote-repping cruisers, neuts, damps, battleship boss, up to 9-ship waves
notes: 2020 Amarr-side counterpart to Crimson Gauntlet; superseded by Tetrimon Base from 2023.

name: Wightstorm Forward Base
space: highsec, inside Volatile Ice Storm systems
enemies: Gated single room. Wave 1 (2-9 ships): 0-6 each of Daunting/Hailburst/Darkling/Numbing Frostwight frigates (scram, web, neuts 3-5 GJ/s), 0-3 Hailburst Icewight and 0-3 Numbing Icewight cruisers (neut 11 GJ/s), 0-2 Hailburst Stormwight battlecruisers (very high damage). Boss: 1 Sansha's Direwight Stormlord commander battleship (~400 DPS, web, point); Darkwight Stormlord (~500 DPS) if a Cryostorm Clarifier was inserted.
ship_limit: T2 Battleship (marauders may enter only if the gate is rerouted with Verity Cryo Tech)
recommended_ship: Doable with a well fit Battlecruiser with application support; event challenge text recommends a T2-fit Battleship
danger_note: Single wave plus 400 DPS battleship boss; rats target drones
notes: Bounties: frigates 50k, cruisers 125k, battlecruisers 250k, battleship 2M. Only the battleship drops loot (ice storm filaments, Nation Stormhive Shards, SKINs, boosters, accelerators, apparel).

name: Wightstorm Muster Point
space: lowsec, inside Volatile Ice Storm systems
enemies: Gated single room. Three waves of 2-9 ships each: 0-6 Frostwight frigates per type (scram, web, neut), 0-3 Hailburst Icewight and 0-3 Numbing Icewight cruisers, 0-2 Hailburst Stormwight battlecruisers. Boss: 1 Sansha's Demonwight Stormlord commander battleship (~600 DPS, very heavy neut, web, point); Deathwight Stormlord if a Cryostorm Reconciler was inserted.
ship_limit: T2 Battleship
recommended_ship: Doable with a well-fit Battleship with application support (Winter Nexus 2021 page)
danger_note: Three waves then 600 DPS heavy-neut battleship boss, in lowsec
notes: Described as the strongest Sansha fleets of the three Wightstorm combat sites. Boss drops 7th-15th tier Overseer's Personal Effects.

name: Wightstorm Transit Site
space: nullsec, inside Volatile Ice Storm systems
enemies: Gated single room. Two waves of 2-9 ships each (same Frostwight/Icewight/Stormwight mix as the other Wightstorm sites). Boss: 1 Sansha's Dreadwight Stormlord commander battleship (~500 DPS at 20 km, web, point); Doomwight Stormlord if a Cryostorm Mapper was inserted.
ship_limit: T2 Battleship
recommended_ship: A very well-tanked battleship is a must-have for the boss; you may need to overheat to tank
danger_note: 500 DPS battleship boss that 'will shred you', in nullsec
notes: Boss drops 9th-23rd tier Overseer's Personal Effects.

name: Wightstorm Anchorage
space: lowsec and nullsec (rare), inside Volatile Ice Storm systems
enemies: Unknown numbers of Frostwight frigates, Icewight/Stormwight cruisers and Stormwight battlecruisers plus 4 Sansha's Nation Starlight/Moonwight Rakshasa dreadnoughts (point, web, neut).
ship_limit: T2 Battleship
danger_note: Four diamond-rat dreadnoughts; fleet content

name: Wightstorm Comms Relay
space: highsec, inside Volatile Ice Storm systems
enemies: No NPCs. Ungated pocket with 1 can ~20 km from warp-in; a Sansha's Stormfield Projector unlocks an extra data relay when loaded with a Cryostatic Estimator. Easy hack (core 50/10).
danger_note: No NPCs; single can
notes: 2021 page lists all Wightstorm data sites as Level IV signatures.

name: Wightstorm Strategic Node
space: lowsec, inside Volatile Ice Storm systems
enemies: No NPCs. Ungated pocket with 1 can ~20 km from warp-in; extra relay unlocked with a Cryostatic Nullifier.
danger_note: No NPCs; single can
notes: 2021 page calls it the hardest hack of the three.

name: Wightstorm Crypto Facility
space: nullsec, inside Volatile Ice Storm systems
enemies: No NPCs. One can; extra relay unlocked with a Cryostatic Suppressor.
danger_note: No NPCs; single can

name: Fading Volatile Ice Field
space: highsec, inside Volatile Ice Storm systems
faction: ORE / Mordu's Legion (friendly); belt rats spotted
enemies: No scripted waves; belt rats have been spotted. Asteroids respawn. Faded Volatile Ice is traded 7:1 to ORE representatives on site for ORE Green Salvage packages (or an ORE Faded Cache with a Cryograph Diffractor).
ship_limit: ORE-commandeered gate: Venture and variants, Pioneer and variants, expedition frigates, mining barges, exhumers, haulers, blockade runners, deep space transports, Noctis, Outrider, Porpoise; not Squall, Deluge or Torrent
danger_note: Highsec mining with occasional belt rats

name: Fresh Volatile Ice Field
space: lowsec, inside Volatile Ice Storm systems
faction: ORE / Mordu's Legion (friendly); local belt rats
enemies: Belt rats will spawn (e.g. 3 battlecruisers, or 1 battleship plus 1 cruiser reported in Guristas lowsec). Fresh Volatile Ice trades for ORE White Salvage packages (Overseer's Personal Effects 9th-16th tier, salvage).
ship_limit: Same ORE mining/hauling gate restriction as Fading Volatile Ice Field
danger_note: Lowsec; belt rats up to battleship reported

name: Friable Volatile Ice Field
space: nullsec, inside Volatile Ice Storm systems
enemies: No details recorded; upgraded salvage package with a Cryograph Exactor.
ship_limit: Same ORE mining/hauling gate restriction as Fading Volatile Ice Field
danger_note: Nullsec mining; rats unrecorded

name: Guardian's Gala
enemies: Waves of Carousing frigates (Dramiel, Daredevil, Maulus, Keres, Vigil, Hyena, Nemesis, Hound: scrams, webs, neuts, damps, painters), destroyers (Catalyst, Talwar), cruisers (Celestis, Vigilant, Exequror remote-rep, Huginn, Cynabal), battlecruisers (Talos, Tornado), battleships (Vindicator, Machariel). Bosses: Guardian's Gala Emcee Vindicator (scram, web) and Emcee Machariel (point, neut) arrive together. Counts per wave not recorded.
recommended_ship: Battleship or Heavy Assault Cruiser; CCP suggests a Battlecruiser but the harder variants may prove difficult without excellent skills and a good fit
danger_note: Two pirate-faction battleship bosses plus heavy EWAR escorts
source: Guardian's Gala (2022); Guardian's Gala Rat Info
notes: Root page calls it an annual February event; last documented instance is 2022. Loot: Bonding accelerators, Agency drugs, 6th-13th tier Overseer's Personal Effects.

name: Guardian's Gala VIP Site
space: wormhole space only, plus Phoenix (Fountain) and Heaven (Curse) constellations in nullsec
enemies: Hardest event variant with the same Carousing NPC roster; bosses are VIP Emcee Vindicator and VIP Emcee Machariel (EWAR not recorded).
recommended_ship: Battleship or Heavy Assault Cruiser (page's general advice; harder variants difficult in a Battlecruiser)
danger_note: Hardest Gala variant, in J-space
source: Guardian's Gala (2022); Guardian's Gala Rat Info

name: Gala Coordination Center
aliases: Gala Network Support Center (name used in the in-game Agency task text)
enemies: No NPCs. Level 3 data site with 6 cans (green and yellow difficulty): Gala Coordination Databanks and Gala Coordination Com Towers.
danger_note: No NPCs; hacking only
notes: Loot: Bonding accelerators, Agency drugs, 5th-8th tier OPE, ORE Research Data Fragments, rare Spirit SKINs, fireworks, normal data loot.

name: Gala VIP Coordination Center
aliases: Gala VIP Network Support Center (Agency task text)
space: wormhole space, plus Phoenix (Fountain) and Heaven (Curse) constellations in nullsec
enemies: No NPCs. Level 4 data site with 6 cans of yellow and red difficulty; more and better loot (up to 13th tier OPE).
danger_note: No NPCs; harder hacks in J-space

name: Guristas Hunt Outpost
space: all of New Eden including wormholes
enemies: Two gated deadspace pockets. Pocket 1: five waves each of 0-3 Hunt Condor, 0-3 Hunt Kestrel, 0-2 Hunt Worm, 0-2 Hunt Griffin frigates (scrams, webs, neuts, ECM), 0-3 Hunt Cormorant and 0-3 Hunt Corax destroyers, 0-1 Hunt Blackbird and 0-1 Hunt Caracal cruisers (very high explosive/EM damage); final wave 1 Guristas Automated VHF-08/VHF-21 commander frigate. Pocket 2 (needs a Hunt Acceleration Gate Key per pilot): 1 Hunt Jackdaw commander destroyer (500 alpha, scram, web, neut), 4 Hunt missile batteries (heavy missiles), 1 web tower, 1 neut tower.
ship_limit: T1, T2 and Faction frigates and destroyers only
recommended_ship: Can be completed in a destroyer tanked against kinetic/thermal damage
danger_note: Frigate/destroyer-gated but heavy scram/neut/ECM and 500-alpha boss
notes: Rats aggress drones. Hunt rats have poor loot; bosses drop OPE 7th-12th tier, SKINs, Guristas modules, Gecko BPCs, Valdimar implants, Hivaa Saitsuo BCS, accelerators. Gate key is consumed on every activation.

name: Guristas Capital Forge
enemies: Single ungated room. 1 Caiman dreadnought on warp-in, then about a dozen Diamond Worms, Gilas and Rattlesnakes.
recommended_ship: Clearly requires a Capital ship or at least a powerful fleet of sub-capitals
danger_note: Dreadnought plus a dozen diamond-class escorts

name: Hunt Data Relay
enemies: No NPCs. Level III. Warp-in room: 4 Hunt Communication Towers (green difficulty) and an acceleration gate consuming a Hunt YC124 Acceleration Gate Key; second room: 5 Hunt Communication Mainframes (yellow). Hacking all four first-room cans despawns the signature.
danger_note: No NPCs; hacking only
notes: Loot: 5th-8th tier OPE, fireworks, filaments, rare SKINs/boosters.

name: Huntmaster Data Relay
enemies: No NPCs. Same layout as Hunt Data Relay but second-room cans are red difficulty with buffed defenses (core 120, suppressor 70, restoration 90); no penalty for failed hacks.
danger_note: No NPCs; hard hacks in lowsec/Venal
notes: Drops 18th-23rd tier OPE, Hivaa Saitsuo BCS, SKINs.

name: Warpath: Defense Complex
faction: Empire enemy NPCs plus named Elite Mercenaries (omni damage)
enemies: Ungated, not deadspaced. One complex (Alpha), 20-minute window. A few friendly and hostile frigates on warp-in (poor tank, low DPS, some warp-disrupt); a named Elite Mercenary in a T1/Navy/Pirate frigate arrives ~30 s later doing 50-100 DPS with point and EWAR. Ships respawn roughly every minute. Hold grid to capture; extraction point with supply cache spawns on completion.
ship_limit: Ungated; only T2, Navy, Pirate and T1 frigates count toward capture
recommended_ship: T1 frigate (the only capture-eligible class)
danger_note: Frigate-only mercenaries at 50-100 DPS with warp disruption

name: Warpath: Defense Grid
faction: Empire enemy NPCs plus named Elite Mercenaries
enemies: Three complexes (Alpha, Beta, Gamma) starting at 90/120/150 defense progress, 25-minute window. Friendly and hostile cruisers in groups of three; Elite Mercenary in a T1/Navy/Pirate cruiser averaging ~200 DPS (Ortega's Vexor Navy Issue 270 DPS EM/Th; Talman's Ashimmu 200 DPS plus 30 GJ/s neut). Ships respawn every minute.
ship_limit: Ungated; capture by T2, Navy, Pirate and T1 cruisers and below
recommended_ship: Cruiser (largest capture-eligible class)
danger_note: Respawning cruiser mercenaries up to 270 DPS with heavy neuts

name: Warpath: War Grid
faction: Empire enemy NPCs plus named Elite Mercenaries
enemies: Three complexes, 30-minute window. Defender and hostile battlecruisers; Elite Mercenary in a T1/Navy/Pirate battleship averaging ~500 DPS (Ruud's Vindicator ~700 DPS Kin/Th with 75% web at 10 km; Talman's Bhaalgorn 500 DPS EM/Th plus ~38 GJ/s neut). Ships respawn every minute.
ship_limit: Ungated; capture by battleships and below
recommended_ship: Battleship (largest capture-eligible class)
danger_note: Pirate battleship mercenaries at 500-700 DPS with webs and heavy neuts

name: Warpath: Intelligence Cache
enemies: No hazards. Level II scanning. 2x <Faction> Intelligence Databank (easy hack: core 70/10). Requires a Data Analyzer.
danger_note: No NPCs or hazards
notes: ~10-15M ISK per site: Warpath Strategic Data (200k each to NPC traders), Warpath Operational Intel, fireworks, old Capsuleer Day SKINs, hardwiring implants.

name: Warpath: Strategic Infiltration
space: lowsec, nullsec and wormholes (also highsec from 26 May 2026, gated)
enemies: No ships unless lockdown is triggered. Hazards: Sentry Nodes (60 DPS omni each, high tracking, hackable to disable), Sentinel/Tripwire proximity nodes, Confinement Nodes (deploy interdiction probes), Siren Node (summons a hostile response fleet; medium hack), Master Security Node (hard hack to end lockdown). 8x <Faction> Strategic Databank (core 70/10 with restoration node). Cloaking or leaving grid starts a 10-minute despawn timer.
ship_limit: In nullsec gated to T1, Pirate and Faction hulls up to cruiser size
danger_note: Lockdown traps: sentries, bubbles and a response fleet if you slip
notes: ~30M ISK per site plus 7M ISK fleet payout for hacking all eight cans. Functionally similar to Observatory Infiltration.

name: Reckoning: Sleeper Forge
enemies: Two rooms, each with an initial spawn of 4 ships and one reinforcement wave of 4, drawn from Stirring/Enervating Pilum and Xyston frigates, Stirring/Enervating Falx destroyers, Risen/Enervating Toxotai cruisers (Enervating variants neut). Room 2 adds 1 Wakeful Sentry Tower; its reinforcement is 1 Utopian Sagaris battleship which drops the loot.
danger_note: Small Sleeper waves with neuts, then a battleship boss
notes: Loot: BPCs, Metal Scrap, Sleeper Protocol Subverter, Signal Beacon, Capsuleer Day SKIN/Booster.

name: Reckoning: Sleeper Foundry
enemies: No composition recorded; lowsec counterpart of Reckoning: Sleeper Forge.
danger_note: Lowsec variant; assumed harder than the Forge, composition unknown

name: Reckoning: Sleeper Reserve
enemies: No NPCs. Level I cosmic signature, ungated, not deadspaced; 3x Ruined Sleeper Depot and 0-1 Preserved Sleeper Depot (rare), easy hacks. Site leaves the probe window after the first can is hacked.
danger_note: No NPCs; hacking only
notes: Loot: metal scraps, salvage, Sleeper Protocol Subverter (100k ISK to NPCs), emission amplifier/limiter BPCs, Sleeper wormhole filament BPCs, boosters, fireworks, resonance beacons, historic Capsuleer Day clothing.

name: Reckoning: Drifter Stockpile
enemies: No NPCs recorded. 3x Drifter Collection (hard red core with firewall, restoration and suppressor nodes) and 1x rare Drifter Prime Collection (adds hard antivirus and restorer nodes).
danger_note: No NPCs; hard hacks in lowsec
notes: Listed under 'Hacking sites'; analyzer type not stated (sibling Sleeper Reserve is a relic site).

name: Small Tyranite Deposit
space: highsec (appears as a beacon on the overview)
enemies: 9 Tyranite asteroids 7-19 km out (~84k/140k units each). Site-specific aggressive belt rats: 1 Crook Watchman and 2 Crook Patroller frigates (damps); regular belt rats also reported. NPC mining fleets (6 Ventures plus a Mastodon) may visit.
danger_note: Three aggressive damping frigates

name: Tyranite Deposit
enemies: 18-25 Tyranite asteroids 23-65 km out; NPC mining fleets (8 Retrievers seen). No rats recorded.
danger_note: No rats recorded

name: Smuggler Hideout
enemies: Class 3, two gated pockets. Possible NPCs: 0-3 Smuggler Raptor, 0-2 Hyena, 0-5 Manticore frigates (points, painters, webs); 0-3 Smuggler Draugur destroyers (neut, spool-up damage); 0-2 each Smuggler Cerberus, Rapier, Ikitursa cruisers; 0-2 Smuggler Tornado battlecruisers. Second room only: 1 Smuggler Underboss battleship (Panther hull: point, neut, web; or Widow hull: point, ECM, neut). Spawn size scales with the largest ship class present (T3 cruisers greatly increase spawns). Full clear ~7.5M ISK bounties.
ship_limit: T2 Battlecruiser, T3 Cruisers
danger_note: Battlecruiser-gated with battleship boss and mixed EWAR
notes: Linked videos show runs in a Drekavac and a Gila. Boss drops Smuggler Lockboxes, event boosters, hardwiring implants.

name: Confiscated Smuggler Hideout
enemies: Class 3, two gated pockets, two waves per room. Possible NPCs: 0-4 each SARO Skybreaker, Pacifier, Nemesis frigates; 0-3 SARO Confessor destroyers; 0-3 each SARO Enforcer, Stormbringer, Curse (heavy neut, GD, TD), Phobos (web, scram) cruisers; 0-2 SARO Talos battlecruisers. Second room only: 1 SARO Captain battleship (Marshal or Thunderchild hull; point, neut, web). Remaining NPCs warp off when the boss dies.
ship_limit: T2 Battlecruiser, T3 Cruisers
danger_note: Battlecruiser-gated, heavy neuts, battleship boss, no bounties
notes: Linked videos show runs in a Drekavac, a Drake and a Gila. Only the boss drops loot (Smuggler Lockboxes, boosters, implants, rare large vorton projector).

name: CONCORD Mobile Impound Lot
enemies: No NPCs. Level III data site (core 70/10).
danger_note: No NPCs; hacking only
notes: Loot: datacores, decryptors, Smuggler Lockbox per can, fireworks, DED boosters, Versus Redforce SKINs, Boobook BPC.

name: Smuggler Dead Drop
enemies: No NPCs. Level III data site.
danger_note: No NPCs; hacking only

name: Guri Malakim Survey Base
faction: Guri Malakim (Guristas and Angel Cartel pirate cooperative)
enemies: Class 3, beacon on warp. Two waves (second is timed) drawn from 0-5 each Guri Malakim Dramiel (web, scram), Griffin (neut, ECM), Worm (point) frigates; 0-3 Cynabal and 0-3 Gila cruisers; 0-2 Tornado battlecruisers (neut). Third wave: 1 Guri Malakim Boss battleship (Rattlesnake or Machariel hull; point, neut, web). ~6.5M ISK bounties.
ship_limit: T2 Battlecruiser, T3 Cruisers
danger_note: Battlecruiser-gated, two waves then pirate battleship boss
notes: Linked video shows a Legion run. Only the boss drops loot.

name: SoCT Survey Expedition
faction: Society of Conscious Thought, EDENCOM and CONCORD (no bounties)
enemies: Class 3. Two waves (second timed) drawn from 0-5 each SoCT Pacifier (neut, point), Skybreaker (TP), Metamorphosis (scram, 3 km orbit) frigates; 0-3 SoCT Sunesis destroyers (web); 0-3 each Stormbringer and Enforcer cruisers; 0-2 Gnosis battlecruisers (neut, web, point). Third wave: 1 SoCT Master battleship (Praxis hull; point, neut, TP, web). All orbit within ~10 km.
ship_limit: T2 Battlecruiser, T3 Cruisers
danger_note: Battlecruiser-gated, close-orbiting EWAR frigates, battleship boss
notes: Infobox on this page is mislabelled 'SoCT Survey Outpost' (that is the hacking site). Boss drops 1st-23rd tier OPE, boosters, implants, Genolution implant.

name: Guri Malakim Raider Base
space: lowsec, nullsec, Pochven and wormhole space
enemies: No composition recorded; non-highsec counterpart of Guri Malakim Survey Base.
ship_limit: Battlecruiser size or smaller (event page)
danger_note: Harder variant in dangerous space; composition unknown

name: SoCT Retrieval Expedition
space: lowsec, nullsec, Pochven and wormhole space
faction: Society of Conscious Thought / EDENCOM / CONCORD
enemies: No composition recorded; non-highsec counterpart of SoCT Survey Expedition.

name: Rampant Drone Fabricator
space: wormholes C1-C6 (infobox); Agency tasks also cite lowsec and Pochven; 5% signature strength in wormholes
faction: Rogue Drones (Fabricator Rogue Drone entity group; 60% EM / 40% Thermal damage)
enemies: Ungated single pocket, up to 100 waves scaling by 'Rampancy' (ship classes on grid). Waves 1-3: 0-3 Corrupted Handler and 0-3 Blackout Driller/Handler frigates (ECM), 0-2 Corrupted Sweeper and 0-2 Bewildering Sweeper/Lathe destroyers (damps); 100-300 DPS. Waves 4-8: add 0-1 Corrupted Divider (370 DPS) and 0-1 Alienator cruiser (web), 0-1 Corrupted Sorter (550 DPS) and 0-1 Scrutinizer battlecruiser (TP); 600-800 DPS. Wave 8+: add Cascade Manager (600 DPS, 600 GJ neut/24 s), Cascade Principal (800 DPS, same neut), Corrupted Manager (740 DPS) battleships; 1000-1200 DPS, capping at ~5 battleships plus escorts past wave 20. Late Severe/Critical threat: 1 Infested Naglfar dreadnought (3800 DPS, ~90-100 GJ/s neut). NPCs leave no wrecks, loot or bounties; all loot is in the Fabricator.
ship_limit: Ungated
recommended_ship: A strongly tanked T3 Cruiser or better is recommended to make any decent progress through the waves (Gallente Election YC128 page)
danger_note: Escalates past 1000 DPS by wave 8; dreadnought spawn; heavy neuts
source: Rampant Drone Fabricator; Gallente Election YC128
notes: EVE news 2026-07-23: 'Rampant Drone Fabricator Sites Are Back!' to stay. Fabricator drops Rampancy data dumps (~200k ISK each) and hybrid drones; invulnerable until wave 5 (patch 24.01). Smartbombs, bombs and vorton projectors heavily nerfed inside; drone boats discouraged.
